thread:
elaine-cs: Quick flag 10 CloudLift renewal10 10 procurement wants invoice to CloudLift UK Ltd but payment coming from CloudLift Global (US card). They need signoff + invoice today to close PO. Any blockers on mixed-entity payor?

raj-am: Are they changing term or pricing? We had an earlier ask to switch to net60 for cashflow.

elaine-cs: They're asking to keep 12mo but switch billing to UK entity and allow net60. In exchange they asked for a one-time 4% "admin" credit. PO: CL-PO-7782. Signer: "Daniela F., Head of Procurement".

marco-legal: Mixed-entity payor is acceptable with conditions. We need either (1) UK VAT reg + vendor code, or (2) signed remit authorization + indemnity clause. For UK invoices sometimes finance requires a wet signature if it's an entity change; however DocuSign is usually fine if signer is authorized. Please capture signer's role and attach PO text.

zoe-fin: Finance note: We can invoice CloudLift UK Ltd in GBP and accept payment via wire to our UK account or accept the US card from CloudLift Global only if we get a payor authorization form + vendor code. Also net60 will affect recognition; approvals needed. If they want the 4% credit, need pricing signoff.

elaine-cs: PO snippet: "Bill To: CloudLift UK Ltd
Payor: CloudLift Global (card)
Vendor Code: CL-VC-19
Terms requested: Net60" Signer: Daniela F., Head of Procurement. I've sent DocuSign for the addendum: https://docusign.com/envelope/CL-ADD-7782

marco-legal: Thanks. Draft addendum language: "Billing Entity Confirmation: Customer confirms CloudLift UK Ltd is the billed entity. CloudLift Global authorizes payment on behalf of the billed entity and will provide VAT registration or indemnify Redwood Inference for any tax exposure resulting from the billing arrangement." Also include a one-paragraph payor authorization form for their finance team to sign.

zoe-fin: I'll prepare two invoice options: (A) GBP invoice to CloudLift UK Ltd with UK wire instructions, (B) GBP invoice with separate payor field and CC fallback note. Holding send until addendum signed or VAT reg provided. ETA 35m.

raj-am: I'll gate the 4% credit until we get legal/finance signoff. If indemnity is required that's a dealbreaker for the credit.

elaine-cs: Sent the DocuSign and asked Daniela to confirm whether they'll attempt wire first and use CC only if wire not cleared by 2025-01-15. Customer replied: "Will try wire; CC as fallback. We'll sign addendum today." :crossed_fingers:

docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope CL-ADD-7782 status: sent (1 pending signer). View: https://docusign.com/envelope/CL-ADD-7782

marco-legal: Once envelope returns signed, if VAT reg missing we'll include indemnity clause and proceed. If VAT reg is provided, we can waive indemnity.

zoe-fin: Noted 10 holding final invoice until signature or VAT confirmation.

elaine-cs: Thanks everyone 10 I'll post when signed or if finance needs anything else. :thumbsup:
